texts.zh: 强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。
texts.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the quantum-entangled signal is utterly unhackable.

title.zh: 战略指挥中心：全面运行

texts.zh: 战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的"敌方军队"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。
texts.en: The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the main system. Within, elite commanders and their staff can become totally immersed in the culture and traditions of our enemies, and by studying their artwork can better understand and simulate their military thinking. Once fully immersed, they will fight virtual wars against the staff of the Strategic Coordination Center, allowing us to stimulate conflicts with any possible enemy in excruciating detail which can then be studied from the perspectives of both sides and our strategies refined upon.

texts.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been some type of "Strategic Coordination Center".

summary.text:
# 战略指挥中心 / Strategic Coordination Center

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/07_strategic_coordination_center.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Megacorp（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工战略指挥中心（见 common/megastructures/07_strategic_coordination_center.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Strategic Coordination Center inside your borders (common/megastructures/07_strategic_coordination_center.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. mega.9003：外结构建成 / Hull built
2. mega.9004：通讯设施建成 / Comms built
3. mega.9005：全面运行 / Fully operational

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- 无（该巨型结构不向其他帝国发送专门通知）/ none (this megastructure sends no dedicated notices to other empires)
- 废墟 The ruin：mega.9110（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_strategic_coordination_center_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；mega.9111 在修复完成后出现。
  mega.9110 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). mega.9111 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.
- 9003 的正文按帝国伦理（如奴役）有所不同（megastructure_events_1.txt:3755-3790）。 The text of 9003 varies with ethics (e.g. slaver; megastructure_events_1.txt:3755-3790).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/07_strategic_coordination_center.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
